items.prompt: What would still need to change before calling this a durable incremental recovery system?
items.modelAnswer: Define and implement file-backed transactional command/outcome/projection+cursor storage, version/source/config binding, checkpoint loader/coherent cut/contiguous suffix, target publication, duplicate/unknown policy and process/OS/storage-fault reopen tests. Keep replay separate from live sends and remote reconciliation. Full pure replay equality alone is not persistence or a live exchange.

criteria.text: Requires version/cursor/coherent target and crash tests.
Separates pure reconstruction from remote effects.
